integration_contract.controller: ProofSettingsDraftController, one per customer in App proofSettingsDrafts ref Map; memory only
integration_contract.callback: onDraftStateChange({ customerId, dirty, pending, unconfirmed }); component reports state in layout effect
integration_contract.synchronous_guard: requestGuardedNavigation reads controller.getSnapshot directly, not asynchronously reported UI state
integration_contract.navigation: proofSettingsNavigationState(customerId, state): clear | pending | confirm. Pending blocks leaving; dirty/unconfirmed prompts while in Customer Settings.
integration_contract.leave_prompt_scope: proof-settings; Keep editing / Discard changes only; no automatic Save. Pending: Stay here, disabled discard. Unconfirmed: Discard local entries with explicit no-undo wording.
integration_contract.discard: Controller.discard() returns false during pending; otherwise resets local inputs to last confirmed policy, makes no request and retains unresolved operation. It cannot undo executed verification/removal.
integration_contract.mutations: onExecute(operation, expectedVersion) returns { policy, notice? } or throws; caller validates customer/shape, guards selected customer and workspace epoch, merges Proof fields only, preserves revoked-link count notice.
integration_contract.readback: onRead() uses existing customer workspace GET with cache:no-store. Matching response confirms; differing response keeps uncertain lock with explicit Use checked settings escape.
integration_contract.explicit_resolution: Use checked settings requires a completed authoritative read; replaces local entries, keeps Previous request reference and warns original request may still complete. No automatic replay. New writes retain expected_policy_updated_at.
integration_contract.background_refresh: Dirty/pending/unconfirmed drafts are not reset by policy.updated_at changes. Dirty policy revision changes require an explicit check; older responses cannot replace newer known policy.
integration_contract.catalog: Development owns separate Catalog dirty/busy integration after this commit. Import/target branches preserved; no Catalog behavior added here.
